Sealant:

Torque: 29 N,m (300 kgf.cm, 22 tt-lbf}
25. REMOVE SNAP RING FROM NO. 2 SHIFT FORK
SHAFT
Using 2 screwdrivers and a hammer, tap out the snap ring.
26. REMOVE STRAIGHT SCREW PLUG, SEAT, SPRING
AND BALL
(a) Using a hexagon wrench, remove the 3 straight screw
plugs.
Sealant:
Part No. 08833--00080, THREE BOND 1344, LOCTITE
242 or equivalent
Torque: 25 N-m {250 kgf.cm, 18 ft•lbf)
{b) Using a magnetic finger, remove the 3 seals, springs and
balls.
27. REMOVE STRAIGHT SCREW PLUG
Using a hexagon wrench, remove the 2 straight screw plugs.
Sealant:
Part No. 08833-00080, THREE BOND 1344, LOCTtTE
242 or equivalent
Torque:
Plug A: 13 N,m (130 kgf.cm, 9 ft.fbf)
Plug B: 39 N.m (400 kgf.cm, 29 ft,lbf)
28. REMOVE TRANSMISSION CASE
(a) Remove the 16 bolts.
Torque: 29 N•m (300 kgf.cm, 22 ft-lbf)
(b) Carefully tap the transmission case with a plastic hammer
and remove it.
